subject: Specifying the likelihood function in R-INLA

messages.author: 1ba76cccc12db9b8
messages.subject: Specifying the likelihood function in R-INLA
parts:
Hello to all INLA experts,


I want to run a survival analysis based on three and four parameter distributions.

Thus, these distributions are not included in the standard distributions.

When we are using the OpenBUGS, we can specify a generic log-likelihood function using

   dummy[i] <- 0
   dummy[i] ~dloglik(logLike[i])
  
where logLike[i] is the contribution to the log-likelihood for the ith observation.

Is there some similar trick in R-INLA?


Thank you for any help,
